approved_claim: In the F11 worked case, on-target PM2 and larger perturbation windows eliminated ALT-supporting parent evidence and removed the pathogenic target VCF call, whereas an identically sized off-target PM2 sham retained 14/14 ALT-supporting parents, the 0/1 genotype, and QUAL 222.202. The ceiling F11 Base GRI arose because the attack produced complete ALT-support loss under the continuous D2 loss-fraction metric and reached S5 under the ordinal D7 terminal-reach metric; the score is not the result of binary success/failure scoring.
prohibited_interpretation: Do not interpret the result as a probability of patient harm. This is not population-level evidence, not a population-wide clinical failure rate, and not external clinical validation.
scope: Single HG002/F11 locus worked case under the tested Dorado/configuration.

Separately, a five-run-per-parameter calibration sweep over cousin-edge probability selected cousin_prob=0.20, yielding mean amplification of 464.4-fold against the 492.86-fold reference target, corresponding to approximately 5.8 percent deviation.
prohibited_interpretation: Do not present 464.4-fold as an observed real-world breach rate or independently validated population estimate.
scope: The 4,144-node/1,657-registered result describes the primary B1 graph reproduction, whereas 464.4-fold is the mean result of a separate stochastic calibration sweep. approved_claim: The locked GenoPhylax Risk Index produced Base GRI 1.0000000000 for the controlled F11 worked case and 0.9115102712 for the model-dependent Privacy worked case. Privacy M3 remains UNMEASURED. Evidence tiers and contextual modifiers remain separate from the Base GRI computation. Because three of the four scored Privacy dimensions (D1, D3, D5) share B2 provenance, equal per-dimension weighting implicitly assigns 75 percent of the Base GRI weight to that model family and 25 percent to B1-derived D6; a correlation-aware 50/50 provenance-family sensitivity was therefore also evaluated, yielding GRI=0.9378168865 (approximately 0.9378).
prohibited_interpretation: Do not interpret GRI as probability of breach, probability of patient harm, clinical risk calibration, or an externally validated universal risk score. Evidence tiers are not numeric GRI multipliers, and unmeasured/N/A dimensions are not zero.
scope: Two worked-case profiles with deterministic sensitivity analysis. Equal per-dimension weighting is a transparent baseline, not an empirically optimized weighting scheme; D1, D3 and D5 share B2 model provenance and are not independent empirical confirmations. The Privacy GRI is not externally calibrated.
